title: Norway's King Harald V Hospitalised for Illness
summary: Norway's King Harald V has been admitted to hospital and placed on sick leave. The 89-year-old monarch is reportedly suffering from a rare blood condition. The Royal Palace announced the hospitalisation and sick leave.
summary_points: King Harald V of Norway has been hospitalised.
He has been placed on sick leave.
The 89-year-old monarch is suffering from a rare blood condition.
The Royal Palace announced the hospitalisation.
